guidance: Plan one independently testable Mod item at a time.
Describe behavior intent and acceptance criteria without inventing lifecycle hook names.
When behavior depends on game APIs, require pinned Truth Evidence during generation.
Define one coherent Character playstyle and a distinct bounded responsibility for every stable item node.
Distribute starting_deck_size exactly across every starter_cards target within the declared per-target bounds.
Plan exactly one PlaceholderCharacterModel root and the Pack-profiled Card, Relic, Potion, and Power nodes.

Set visual_profile to the Pack-declared placeholder or branded_placeholder requested by the concept; default to placeholder only when no branded identity is requested. Map HP, gold, energy, gender, name color, placeholder identity, and every declared localization field explicitly.
Pin every Card in the Character cards slot, every Relic in relics, every Potion in potions, and every Power in powers so the root reaches the complete closure.
Use starting_deck quantities to close exactly to starting_deck_size, and include exactly starter_card_types distinct starting Card definitions.

Bind every Card, Relic, and Potion owner_character identity to the root; Character registration is CustomContentDictionary.AddCharacter through CustomCharacterModel, while PoolAttribute is only for Card, Relic, and Potion pool membership.
Revise only the requested Character suite node while preserving its declared role in the surrounding suite.
Keep its behavior, bilingual localization, ownership, and root reachability coherent with the supplied Draft graph.
Follow the shared composition structure rules supplied with this request; do not add, remove, or rename another node.
Generate complete C# source files that compile in the active project.
Use only API and lifecycle symbols supported by the supplied Truth Evidence.
Do not emit binary resources, project files, build commands, or paths outside declared file roles.
Implement only the requested behavior and keep all game API claims grounded in Truth Evidence.
Generate one PlaceholderCharacterModel plus its CustomCardPoolModel, CustomRelicPoolModel, and CustomPotionPoolModel in the declared source role.
Map visual_profile, placeholder_id, name_color, gender, starting_hp, starting_gold, and max_energy exactly from the ItemDefinition.

When visual_profile is branded_placeholder, override CustomIconTexturePath, CustomIconPath, CustomCharacterSelectIconPath, CustomCharacterSelectLockedIconPath, and CustomMapMarkerPath with the five selected Resource paths under {mod_id}/images/characters/{item_id}; keep PlaceholderID scene, animation, transition, energy, hand, and audio reuse unchanged.
When visual_profile is placeholder, do not override any static Character image path and require no selected Character Resources.
For BaseLib 3.3.8, implement the CustomCardPoolModel Title, IsColorless, and DeckEntryCardColor requirements; CustomPotionPoolModel has no ParentPool override.
Build StartingDeck and StartingRelics only from pinned reference bindings, preserving quantities; use the complete Card, Relic, and Potion pinned sets for the corresponding custom pools.
Do not put PoolAttribute on the Character. CustomCharacterModel registers through CustomContentDictionary.AddCharacter; PoolAttribute remains required on owned Card, Relic, and Potion models.
Emit every Pack-declared Character localization field under the exact STS2 characters table key for both locales.
Emit the four required THE_ARCHITECT Character dialogue keys in the STS2 ancients table for both locales.
Generate one STS2 relic implementation whose locked rarity and bilingual localization match the ItemDefinition.
Use owner_character when present to select the Character's CustomRelicPoolModel; otherwise use the shared pool. Use only registration APIs present in Truth Evidence.
Emit flat localization key-value JSON for both required locales.
Generate one STS2 card implementation and map pool, card_type, rarity, target, and base_cost exactly from the ItemDefinition.
When pool is custom_character, derive the custom CardPool type from owner_character; otherwise declare the selected built-in pool. Use only supported card APIs and enum values.
Emit flat localization key-value JSON with title, description, and upgrade_description values for both required locales.
Generate one STS2 potion implementation and map rarity, usage, and target exactly from the ItemDefinition.
Use owner_character when present to select the Character's CustomPotionPoolModel; otherwise register in the shared potion pool. Use only supported APIs.
Use the selected potion.icon resource through a custom packed image path and emit flat title/description localization JSON for both required locales.
Generate one STS2 power implementation and map power_type, stack_type, instance_type, and allow_negative exactly from the ItemDefinition.
Extend CustomPowerModel and use only lifecycle hooks, stacking behavior, and PowerCmd operations supported by Truth Evidence; do not invent hooks.
Use the selected power.icon and power.big resources through the custom packed and big icon paths, and emit flat title/description localization JSON for both required locales.

ecosystems.label: .NET compiler
interpretations: A compiler diagnostic is normally downstream of a missing reference, incompatible API version, or incorrect namespace.
Use the first compiler error as the primary signal because later errors may be cascading failures.
checks: Compare referenced API symbols with the pinned Truth Snapshot.
Confirm the project targets the framework version required by the installed mod toolchain.

ecosystems.label: MSBuild and dotnet publish
interpretations: Restore, reference resolution, compilation, and publish are distinct stages; identify the earliest failing target.
A publish failure can occur after compilation succeeds and should not be reported as a source-code failure.
checks: Identify the failing target and task before proposing a project-file change.
Check output and dependency paths without exposing absolute user paths.

ecosystems.label: Godot runtime
interpretations: Runtime resource or node errors are separate from managed compilation and packaging failures.
The first engine error generally has more diagnostic value than repeated follow-on stack entries.
checks: Verify the packaged resource path and case exactly match the runtime reference.
Distinguish engine startup failures from mod initialization failures.

ecosystems.label: BaseLib mod lifecycle
interpretations: A mod can compile and publish successfully but fail during discovery, initialization, or patch application.
Lifecycle ordering and API compatibility must be supported by pinned Truth Evidence.
checks: Locate the earliest mod discovery or initialization failure.
Compare lifecycle symbols and hook signatures with the selected Truth Snapshot.

priorities: Report the earliest actionable root cause before cascading symptoms.
Separate build, publish, package, game startup, and mod initialization stages.
Mark an explanation as a hypothesis when the supplied log and Truth Evidence do not prove it.
